title: Mysterious Artefact
summary: The bound Astral Prism protects the party from the Absolute during story scenes.

fields.Bound: It cannot be removed from its current holder’s inventory. Inspect it without opening it.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Shadowheart. If she is absent, it moves to a party member when the Absolute’s influence triggers near the Goblin Camp or Mountain Pass. The party obtains it by the end of Act One.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
